Convert relative speed to m/min = 3 × (1000/60) = 50 m/min.

Distance reduced in 8 minutes = 50 × 8 = 400 m.

Remaining distance = 500 − 400 = 100 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 100 m.**

questions.question: A person travels equal distances at speeds of 3 km/h, 4 km/h, 7 km/h and 12km/h, and takes a total of 680 minutes. What is the total distance (in km) travelled?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let each equal distance segment be the LCM of speeds (3, 4, 7, 12) = 84 km.

Assumed total time for 4 × 84 km = (84/3) + (84/4) + (84/7) + (84/12) = 28 + 21 + 12 + 7 = 68 hours.

Actual total time given = 680 minutes = 680 ÷ 60 = 68/6 hours.

Distance multiplier = Actual Time ÷ Assumed Time = (68/6) ÷ 68 = 1/6.

Total distance = Assumed Total Distance × Multiplier = (4 × 84) × (1/6) = 336 ÷ 6 = 56 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 56 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4fff1348c437aaf1353ab798416c0816fc3ef933ed65b7e9934221c31c7ee0c.png] 

**Given:**

Speeds of the four equal segments = 3 km/h, 4 km/h, 7 km/h, and 12 km/h.

Total time taken = 680 minutes = 680/60 hours = 34/3 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Total Distance = 4 × Distance of one segment

**Calculation:**

Let the equal distance traveled at each speed be d km.

⇒ Total distance = 4d km.

⇒ Total time = (d/3) + (d/4) + (d/7) + (d/12)

⇒ LCM of 3, 4, 7, and 12 is 84.

⇒ Total time = (28d + 21d + 12d + 7d) ÷ 84

⇒ Total time = 68d / 84 = 17d / 21 hours

According to the problem, the total time is 34/3 hours.

⇒ 17d / 21 = 34 / 3

⇒ d = (34 × 21) ÷ (17 × 3)

⇒ d = 2 × 7 = 14 km.

⇒ Total distance = 4d = 4 × 14 = 56 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 56 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for n Equal Distances

If an object covers n equal distances at speeds S₁, S₂, ... Sₙ, the average speed is given by the harmonic mean: Average Speed = n ÷ (1/S₁ + 1/S₂ + ... + 1/Sₙ).

General Average Speed Formula

For unequal distances or times, the average speed is strictly the ratio of total distance covered to the total time taken: Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Relative Speed Concept

When two bodies move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds (S₁ − S₂). If moving in opposite directions, it is the sum of their speeds (S₁ + S₂).

questions.question: P drives a car for 5 hours and after every hour he doubles the speed. In the fifth hour, his speed is 128 km/h. What is his average speed of the journey in km/h?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When time intervals are equal, Average Speed = Arithmetic mean of all speeds.

The speeds for the 5 hours form a geometric sequence ending in 128: 8, 16, 32, 64, 128 km/h.

Sum of speeds = 8 + 16 + 32 + 64 + 128 = 248 km/h.

Average Speed = 248 ÷ 5 = 49.6 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 49.6 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total time taken for the journey = 5 hours

Speed in the 5th hour = 128 km/h

The speed doubles after every hour.

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9533fefa47ceafafc28df96db79fe94ca57af14bd73302bbbc550bc1d69f3473.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the speed in the 1st hour be v km/h.

Speeds in consecutive hours follow the pattern: 2v, 4v, 8v, 16v.

⇒ Speed in the 5th hour = 16v = 128

⇒ v = 128 ÷ 16 = 8 km/h

The distance covered in each 1-hour interval is numerically equal to the speed:

⇒ Distance in 1st hour = 8 × 1 = 8 km

⇒ Distance in 2ⁿd hour = 16 × 1 = 16 km

⇒ Distance in 3rd hour = 32 × 1 = 32 km

⇒ Distance in 4th hour = 64 × 1 = 64 km

⇒ Distance in 5th hour = 128 × 1 = 128 km

⇒ Total Distance = 8 + 16 + 32 + 64 + 128 = 248 km

⇒ Average Speed = 248 ÷ 5 = 49.6 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 49.6 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

Average speed is defined as the total distance traveled divided by the total time taken. It is not the simple average of individual speeds unless the time intervals for each speed are strictly equal.

Equal Time Intervals Rule

If an object travels at different speeds v₁, v₂, ..., vₙ for equal durations of time, the average speed is simply the arithmetic mean of all the speeds: (v₁ + v₂ + ... + vₙ) ÷ n.

Geometric Progression (GP)

A sequence of numbers where each term after the first is found by multiplying the previous one by a fixed, non-zero number (common ratio). The sum of a GP is computed as Sₙ = a(rⁿ − 1) ÷ (r − 1) for r > 1.
</p

questions.question: A policeman is chasing a thief at a speed of 12 km/h, and the thief is running at a speed of 8 km/h. If the policeman started 30 minutes late, find the time taken by the policeman to catch the thief.

Lead distance of thief = Speed × Time = 8 × (30/60) = 4 km.

Relative speed = Policeman speed − Thief speed = 12 − 8 = 4 km/h.

Time to catch = Lead distance ÷ Relative speed = 4 ÷ 4 = 1 hour.

Time in minutes = 1 × 60 = 60 minutes.

questions.question: A thief takes off on his bike at a certain speed, after seeing a police car at a distance of 250 m. The police car starts chasing the thief and catches him. ⇒ Speed of Police : Speed of Thief = 7 : 6

Given 7 units = 70 km/h ⇒ 1 unit = 10 km/h

⇒ Speed of Thief = 6 units = 60 km/h

questions.question: On a circular path of 693 m, Sujata and Anjali start walking from the same point but in the opposite directions at the speed of 2.85 km/h and 1.5 m/sec, respectively. When they will meet for the first time?

Relative speed = 0.79 + 1.5 = 2.29 m/s

Time = Distance/relative speed
